{"notes":"From esol.10: 07:207 (Ch 23) still says BLOCKED_USER -> REPLY_REJECTED/blocked-user; batch reply endpoint has no response format; no reason code for future-dated published (TIMESTAMP_SKEW?).
From esol.4: Operator Manifest self-signature -> attached JWS (Ch 34), corundumType OperatorManifest, kid = manifest key id. keys[].algorithm values -> JOSE alg names ('Ed25519'). RFC 9421 alg param uses 9421 registry name 'ed25519'. Ch 21: replace reply.signingRecord schema with detached JWS SigningRecord (Ch 12); drop reply.contentHash (CID covers it); require activity bytes inline or fetched by id. From esol.3: attributedTo/parentAuthor/ipns:// refs in 07 -> DIDs.
From esol.3: 07:188 requireVerifiedIdentity: every user now has a DID; redefine as 'DID method with recovery (not did:key)' or drop. Ch 17/18 operators no longer hold user update keys; content key operator-held by default.
From esol.11: Ch 19 example still alg="ed25519-v1"."}
